notes: Front label reads Sculpterra 2022 Primitivo, 100% Primitivo. Back label: Paso Robles appellation; Frankel Family Estate & Tom Bordonaro vineyards; harvested in 3 lots; fermented in stainless tanks and new 500L oak barrels; aged 10 months in oak, apparently 42% new American; bottled August 2023; 765 cases produced.
style: High-ABV Paso Robles Primitivo; likely ripe, full-bodied, oak-influenced red.
recommendation_signals: Neutral household signal for high-ABV Paso Robles Primitivo / Sculpterra; acceptable but not a standout.
Adds another neutral data point for ripe Paso Robles reds, alongside earlier neutral Paso Robles Zinfandel-style notes.
